title: Safer joining, 20-hour privacy clock, permanent game record, bigger write guard
changes: Joining: an employee ID or a mobile number is checked against the organizer's list (the organizer may accept either), a stranger waits for the organizer's yes, one phone cannot play as another (every vote, every game-over answer and every people call must carry the phone's own device proof; a forged one is answered 403), and the same person joining twice gets the same place back
A game for up to 10 people is Rs 0: the 11th person is refused, the same phone gets the same place

Privacy: players' names, numbers and seats are deleted 20 hours after the game ends (the promise stays 24 hours), the organizer's report link stops after 19 hours, and the owner's alarm rises only after 3 more hours; a late scheduler is covered by the lazy tick
A permanent record of each game's settings is kept (no personal data in it): the owner reads it at /api/owner/game-records

Payment: a payment is finished exactly once even when the browser and the payment provider's webhook arrive together, and a second order is refused while one is being confirmed. Every payment still goes through the one payment website of IT Services by Rajat Agarwal and its single gateway (Razorpay)

Limits: the daily database-write guard is raised to 2,000,000 (a runaway guard only, the account is on the paid Workers plan); one network address may open more places a minute (a whole office shares one address); only drafts that were never published count toward the limit of ten, so a published game waiting for payment never blocks a new game

Sign-in: a wrong 6-digit code is counted before it is compared, so guesses sent at the same moment cannot all slip under the limit of five; the owner's three test sign-ins are limited per network and never mailed
A demo link (POST /api/pass, zc.html?pass=) can give one account one free game; no link is installed in this game

Not brought over because this game does not have them: claims and the claim window, host-called numbers, the present check-in, the question about people who finish together, and turning a demo into a real game

title: Employee ID or mobile number, PDF people list, Rs 0 game for 10 people
changes: The organizer chooses per game what a person gives to get in: name only, a mobile number, an employee ID, or both; employees only keeps the game to the people on the list
The people list takes an Employee ID column (type, paste, CSV, and a PDF read on the organizer's own device)
Games for up to 10 people cost Rs 0
Console colours and hints; three test sign-ins; the random-number service is asked from the next mirror after a short wait

title: Realistic dice, installable app, a player's own rights
changes: Player screens: a realistic dice that rolls and lands, the target first, a score badge
The game can be installed as an app on the phone
A player can leave at any time and ask what is held about them, to correct it or to delete it

title: Corporate Luck by Chance goes on the web
changes: 10 rounds of 10 dice rounds, a press window of 10 seconds, the most points wins; the target and every dice are made from public random data
Players join by name only unless the organizer asks for an employee ID or a mobile number
Payment through the central payment service, report by e-mail, personal data deleted after the game
